instruction: I liked that last t-shirt I bought on amazon. Place a new order for the same in black and green, one each. Make sure to get the size as per that order, and have them delivered home.
notes: Single-app task (amazon) plus supervisor. The last purchased t-shirt (last-tshirt) is identified via show_product_purchases; show_product on it reveals its color/size variants (variants-known). add_product_to_cart is constrained to variants of the purchased product whose color is a wanted color (black, green) and whose relative size equals the purchased product's size, quantity 1 each; distractor variants in another size are included to show the size constraint matters. clear_cart precedes adding so the placed order contains exactly the two items (CartEntry changes are ignored by evaluation, but the order must contain only these two products). place_order requires two distinct in-cart variants, the home address (home-address static fact, found via show_addresses) and a payment card (show_payment_cards); its effect marks both products ordered and the order delivered to home. supervisor.complete_task carries the two ordered products and the delivery address as non-API record parameters so its precondition mirrors the problem goal; it is enforced last via (not (task-completed)) on every action. No answer is needed.

plan: (amazon-add-product-to-cart tshirt-black amazon-token qty-1 last-tshirt black ordered-size)
(amazon-add-product-to-cart tshirt-green amazon-token qty-1 last-tshirt green ordered-size)
